message:
The yen receipt test passes now, and the full suite is green (18/18).

The bug was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, which is right for pounds and dollars but wrong for yen, which has no minor unit. A ¥500 receipt was coming out as "¥5.00".

The fix adds a `ZERO_DECIMAL` set containing `JPY`. For those currencies the amount is printed as whole units, so ¥500 renders as "¥500". Other currencies are unchanged. I fixed it in the shared helper, so invoices, cart and admin get the same correction. The helper currently only lists JPY; other zero-decimal currencies such as KRW would need adding to that set.

I haven't committed the change.
